Subject: Regional processing commitments, DPIA scoping and VPC options

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before we move to procurement we need written confirmation on a few security and privacy items for HealthBridge (we process special category health data):

- Can Redwood commit to EU-only processing for our account (data-at-rest and processing) and provide a short technical description of how routing is guaranteed?
- We need to understand VPC/Private Connect options: can you provide an architecture diagram and whether we get a dedicated regional pool or shared tenancy in eu-west?
- Please share the DPA amendment, your view on SCCs applicability, and whether Redwood will sign Business-Controller-to-Processor SCCs.
- Provide SOC 2 Type II summary and a completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ if available.
- We also need a DPIA scoping note — will Redwood assist with a DPIA workshop and provide evidence for technical measures (KMS, key separation, logging, retention controls)?

Target timeline: we need the evidence bundle within two weeks to keep our procurement window. Can you confirm feasibility and next steps?

Thanks,
Elena

Head of Procurement
HealthBridge GmbH

Thanks Hannah — quick legal/controls update: 

- DPA/SCCs: Legal can produce a DPA addendum with a standard clause committing to EU-only processing where customer selects "Region: EU" and uses Redwood Private or Dedicated; we'll include the current SCCs (European Commission 2021) for Controller->Processor flows. We require the customer signature on the DPA addendum and execution of SCCs to finalize contractual EU-only commitment.
- DPIA: Given HealthBridge processes health data, a DPIA is very likely required. Redwood can support via a short scoping workshop (1 hour) and provide a DPIA evidence pack (technical description, risk mitigations, logging/retention, KMS model). We'll note residual risks (cross-region failover scenarios) and list controls to mitigate them.
- Evidence: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and the relevant SOC 2 control mapping. For SIG/CAIQ, we can provide our latest completed CAIQ export and a SIG-lite mapping; full SIG answers may take longer (we can prioritize the highest-risk sections).

Blockers/notes: For a contractually binding EU-only processing guarantee, we must restrict failover policies (no automatic cross-region processing) or provide explicit fallback rules agreed in the DPA. Marcus please confirm whether our Dedicated/EU Private Connect options can support a hard routing policy. Olga — confirm the SOC2 summary and whether additional pen-test evidence is needed.

Neha
Head of Legal Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Schreiber <elena.schreiber@healthbridge.de>

Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 16:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Regional processing commitments, DPIA scoping and VPC options

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and next steps below; attachments & links are included. Happy to walk through any item on a call this week.

1) EU-only processing routing
- Commitment: Redwood can contractually commit to EU-only processing for HealthBridge when you choose Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private (VPC Private Connect) and execute the DPA addendum + SCCs. This will restrict request routing to our eu-west (Primary) and eu-central (Secondary) pools only.
- Fallbacks: We will not enable automatic cross-region processing except under customer-approved emergency fallbacks. Any fallback policy will require advance written approval.

2) VPC / Private Connect architecture
- We support Private Connect (customer VPC peering + PrivateLink) with an option for a dedicated regional pool (isolated GPU fleet) or a shared but tenant-isolated environment. Dedicated pools provide stronger guarantees on tenancy and routing. See attached architecture diagram.

3) DPA / SCCs
- Attached: redwood_dpa_addendum_v1.docx and sccs_excerpts_2026.pdf. We will include Controller->Processor SCCs and practical guidance for execution.

4) Evidence (SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ)
- Attached: soc2_type2_summary_2026.pdf. We can also supply a CAIQ export and SIG-lite mapping in the Drive folder linked below; full SIG may take additional time.

5) DPIA support
- Redwood will run a 60-minute DPIA scoping workshop with your DPO to capture processing details and provide a DPIA evidence pack (technical measures, retention, KMS key separation, logging/tracing, access controls). We will highlight residual risks and proposed mitigations.

Timeline & next steps
- Evidence bundle: we can compile and share the attachments above plus CAIQ export within 10 business days, subject to final sign-off on the DPA addendum.
- Please confirm if you require a dedicated regional pool (preferred) or if shared tenancy with strict routing rules is acceptable.
- If you confirm, I'll route the DPA to DocuSign and schedule the DPIA workshop with Neha and our security team.

Links & attachments

- DPA DocuSign: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/DPA-DEAL-98123
